# Ivan de Murard

> Product builder based in Paris. Five years across start-ups, scale-ups and large groups, plus two years co-founding Sonor (B2G SaaS). Designs from operational experience, ships with AI, keeps the human at the center. Focus areas: agentic AI, boutique hotel operations, service design, SaaS, open data.

## Case studies

- [Aetherix](https://ivandemurard.com/aetherix): F&B Execution Node of the Hospitality Agentic Mesh. Anticipates staffing and F&B needs in real time, reduces food waste and operational costs, frees teams to focus on guest experience. Stack: Apaleo PMS, FastAPI, Prophet, pgvector, HiveMemory, Claude Sonnet (Gemini and GPT fallback), MCP Server v0 live on Fly.io.
- [Lore](https://ivandemurard.com/lore): Voice AI mentor for aviation maintenance. Captures what a retiring technician knows and never wrote down, then gives it back to a junior on the shop floor by voice. Three modes: Capture, Query, Log. The procedure always wins, the senior's judgement always arrives attributed by name and month. Built in 24 hours at Speechmatics x AI Collective Paris, Feb 2026, developed solo since. Prototype: synthetic procedures, mock aircraft data, evaluation harness in CI. Stack: Speechmatics real-time STT, OpenAI GPT-4o, Backboard, OpenAI TTS, Next.js 14, TypeScript, Tailwind, Vercel.
- [Sonor](https://ivandemurard.com/sonor): Two-year journey as Co-founder & Product Lead. Turned open data into a B2G SaaS used by municipalities to map urban noise and drive sustainability policy.
- [Tacet](https://ivandemurard.com/tacet): Headless Environmental Twin for hospitality, exposed via an MCP server. A 3D ray-tracing physics engine plus a dual memory store (idiosyncratic and hive mind) turns street, weather and crowd signals into human-approved yield rules and Chain of Thought payloads for RMS, PMS and orchestration agents like Aetherix.

## Track record

- 2024 to 2025, Product Manager at FORTIL for DomusVi: rolled out an internal SaaS to 500+ users across 100 care homes.
- 2023 to 2024, Product Manager at ALTEN for Bouygues Telecom: data-driven dashboard recovered 40% of 1.9M EUR receivables.
- 2022 to 2023, Customer Success Manager at Opendatasoft: 22 European city and metropolitan clients, 2 launches, zero churn.
- 2020 to 2022, Co-founder & Product Manager at Sonor: 0 to 1 B2G SaaS, backed by Matrice and Banque des Territoires, 20K EUR in grants.
